entries: Plans and delivers park nature, history, and science guided tours, talks, or educational activities.

paragraphs: The inputs are park materials, audience needs, season, and open areas; the outputs are routes, scripts, live commentary, question records, and improvements.
Before starting, verify the park open areas, activity permits, weather, accessibility, and wildlife protection requirements.
Explains ecology, geology, or history on site with verifiable examples, and does not present guesses as facts.
When visitors are injured, go missing, or approach a dangerous area, first follow park procedures and notify the responsible personnel.
Maps, signage, images, and multimedia assist the interpretation and cannot replace field verification and on-site judgment.
Work is often outdoors and involves weather, walking, group management, and public questions.

O*NET tasks also include caring for park program animals, training staff and volunteers, coordinating seasonal staff activities, plant, animal, and forest surveys, routine facility maintenance, and emergency duties; the specific work and authority are decided by the employer and local rules, and the occupational title does not automatically grant law enforcement, rescue, or wildlife handling authority.
Park naturalists focus on public education, guided tours, and interpreting park resources; conservation scientists focus more on resource survey, analysis, and management.
Compared with a tour guide, this position requires deeper park natural history knowledge and educational design; the specific duties depend on the organization.
When comparing directions, look at public interpretation, on-site safety, resource research, and whether management or law enforcement authority is involved.

salary.china_open: The official National Forestry and Grassland Administration examples show park management agencies running natural science interpretation, courses, and Q&A; the position tasks can be compared, and the wage should first verify the actual employer's industry. The NBS 2025 pre-tax annual average is 70,172 yuan for urban non-private units and 49,527 yuan for private units in water conservancy, environment, and public facilities management; the two populations are not a salary lower and upper bound. Only actual legal-person employers in park, scenic area, or ecological protection management that fall in this industry serve as industry background, not the park naturalist median, percentiles, starting pay, or take-home income. Educational institutions, travel agencies, cultural venues, and administrative agencies must be verified separately by their actual industry and cannot be applied merely by the name of nature education or interpretation.
